what_we_collect_when_you: What we collect when you write to us, and nothing more.
only_what_you_type_into: Only what you type into the contact form: your email, product, topic and message.
nothing_your_message_goes_straight: Nothing. Your message goes straight to our support mailbox.
none_no_analytics_no_advertising: None. No analytics, no advertising or tracking cookies.
see_correct_or_delete_your: See, correct or delete your data, or object. Ask through the contact form.
this_site_and_the_g: This site and the G.A.W.Digital apps are run by G.A.W.Group, s.r.o. We are the controller of your personal data.
the_contact_form_or_a: The contact form, or a letter to the address above.
your_email_address_the_product: Your email address, the product and topic you choose, and your message. We use them only to answer you.
cloudflare_turnstile_checks_that_a: Cloudflare Turnstile checks that a person is using the form. It processes technical signals from your browser: your IP address, browser user agent and TLS fingerprint.
our_host_cloudflare_processes_your: Our host, Cloudflare, processes your IP address and traffic data to deliver the pages.
help_report_a_problem_in: Help ▸ Report a Problem… in an app drafts a message in your own mail app. We receive only what you choose to send.
our_apps_are_sold_on: Our apps are sold on the Mac App Store. Apple handles the purchase under its own privacy policy{{ext}}(opens in a new tab). We receive no payment details.
we_rely_on_our_legitimate: We rely on our legitimate interests (Art. 6(1)(f) GDPR):
replying_to_the_people_who: Replying to the people who write to us, about our apps or anything else.
keeping_the_form_free_of: Keeping the form free of automated abuse.
you_can_object_to_this: You can object to this at any time (see Your rights). We do not use your data for marketing, and we make no automated decisions about you.
hosts_this_site_on_cloudflare: Hosts this site on Cloudflare Workers, runs Turnstile and passes form messages on to our support mailbox. Cloudflare, Inc., USA.
hosts_our_support_mailbox_where: Hosts our support mailbox, where your message is stored. Blueboard.cz Webhosting s.r.o., Czech Republic.
both_process_the_data_on: Both process the data on our instructions, under data processing terms. Blueboard keeps it in the EU. Where Cloudflare processes data outside the EU, it is certified under the EU–US Data Privacy Framework, and its terms include the EU standard contractual clauses.
cloudflare_also_uses_turnstiles_signals: Cloudflare also uses Turnstile’s signals as a controller in its own right, to improve its bot detection. See its Turnstile Privacy Addendum{{ext}}(opens in a new tab).
this_site_stores_nothing_the: This site stores nothing. The form passes your message on and keeps no copy.
in_our_support_mailbox_we: In our support mailbox we keep it until your request is resolved, then at most 12 months.
no_analytics_advertising_or_tracking: No analytics, advertising or tracking cookies.
one_item_theme_keeps_your: One item, theme, keeps your day or night choice. It stays in your browser; clear it there at any time.
your_choice_of_cs_en: Your choice of CS, EN or DE is part of the page address.
ask_what_data_we_hold: Ask what data we hold about you and get a copy. (Art. 15 GDPR)
have_wrong_data_corrected_art: Have wrong data corrected. (Art. 16 GDPR)
have_your_data_deleted_art: Have your data deleted. (Art. 17 GDPR)
have_its_use_limited_for: Have its use limited, for example while its accuracy is checked. (Art. 18 GDPR)
object_to_processing_based_on: Object to processing based on our legitimate interests. (Art. 21 GDPR)
use_the_contact_form_or: Use the contact form or write to our address. We answer within one month.
you_can_also_complain_to: You can also complain to the Office for Personal Data Protection (ÚOOÚ), Pplk. Sochora 27, 170 00 Praha 7, uoou.gov.cz{{ext}}(opens in a new tab), or to the authority where you live or work in the EU.
if_we_change_how_we: If we change how we handle your data, we update this page and its date.
